task_name: ZM3D July 2025 event/lives scheduler outage root cause + remediation workstream
authoring_notes: Expert Assessment: short falsifiable criteria (guideline style); degree in score_bands; non-negative only; no penalties. OC owns fact-level binary checks.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent's incident-register entry states an exclude-or-annotate call for the July 12-26, 2025 window and places blockers/gaps before the itemized findings.
rubrics.justification: The prompt asks for gaps at the top and one clear diligence-window call; a senior reader needs both in the filing.
rubrics.evidence: The register has blockers/gaps above the item list and an exclude-or-annotate (or equivalent) call for July 12-26, 2025.

score_bands.label: missing
score_bands.description: No exclude-or-annotate call and no blockers/gaps section before the findings.

score_bands.label: partial
score_bands.description: Has either the call or blockers/gaps first, but not both.

score_bands.label: complete
score_bands.description: Has blockers/gaps first and an exclude-or-annotate call for July 12-26, 2025.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent's opened outage incident record states the July 12-26, 2025 window, the stalled-scheduler root cause, and the locked ~30% impact.
rubrics.justification: OC checks that a record was opened; this checks whether the record carries the three fields a data-room reader needs.
rubrics.evidence: The opened incident record includes the July 12-26, 2025 window, stalled-scheduler root cause, and locked ~30% impact.

score_bands.label: stub
score_bands.description: Record omits at least two of: window, root cause, locked ~30%.

score_bands.label: partial
score_bands.description: Record includes exactly two of: window, root cause, locked ~30%.

score_bands.label: complete
score_bands.description: Record includes window, stalled-scheduler root cause, and locked ~30%.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent creates one distinct ticket per Engine-page remediation, not a single catch-all remediation ticket.
rubrics.justification: OC checks tickets exist; this checks the five remediations stay separately trackable.
rubrics.evidence: Five distinct remediation tickets exist, one per Engine-page remediation item.

score_bands.label: collapsed
score_bands.description: Remediations missing, or bundled into one catch-all ticket.

score_bands.label: partial
score_bands.description: Some remediations are separate tickets; at least one is missing or merged.

score_bands.label: complete
score_bands.description: Five distinct tickets, one per Engine-page remediation.

rubrics.criterion: The Agent's channel summaries and stakeholder DMs each state the exclude-or-annotate call and name at least one concrete gap.
rubrics.justification: OC checks the messages were sent; this checks each carries call plus gap content.
rubrics.evidence: zombie-ops, live-incidents, and DMs to Douglas, Arthur Blake, and Frederick Stone each include the call and one concrete gap.

score_bands.label: empty
score_bands.description: Messages omit both the call and any concrete gap.

score_bands.label: partial
score_bands.description: Some messages include the call or a gap; others do not.

score_bands.label: complete
score_bands.description: All five messages state the call and name at least one concrete gap.
